reviews.text: Very nice place, good service

Besides mistreating animals, they're rude and block you.
I tried to make an appointment for my dog ​​and asked if they could handle it gently, to which they got angry and blocked me.

Terrible customer service.
If you can, avoid the hassle of going here.
They are excellent.

HORRID. I had an appointment for 1 PM, but when I arrived there were 45 dogs ahead of me. Why make people come if you're just going to treat them however you want? Besides, the staff was incredibly rude, especially the young woman.
The lady who greets you is incredibly rude and the service is awful, don't go there!!!

Terrible service, they don't give you a receipt and they even overcharge you for the service. I told them I just wanted a bath and in the end they gave me a haircut and charged me extra. It's awful service, you're better off finding another salon that is serious and responsible and that issues a receipt.

This is the first time I've taken my puppy there, and everything seems fine. I'm not giving it 5 stars because you have to ask how it went, and it took 3 hours for a standard service. It would also be great if they updated their vet listings. They didn't have anything I saw on their page.
I absolutely do not recommend this place. I took my two dogs there, and they were returned to me badly injured with cuts and mangled fur. Don't take them here; save yourself the trouble.
Thank you
Excellent service and they make the little ones look really beautiful.
Excellent service! I took my dog ​​in for a dental cleaning and he did great! Thank you so much!

I had trusted them completely for years, leaving my Yorkie with them. From now on, I'll never go back!!!! 16 years 😡
I brought them a picture of how I wanted her groomed. The girl who receives the dogs doesn't even look at you; she's always grumpy and has a terrible attitude. I told her what I wanted, and without further ado, she said the only thing they could do for her was shave her! Her fur was healthy, and because they were too lazy to do it, she said that was the only option.

When Armando was working there, these things didn't happen 😡😡😡
When they gave her back to me, I was furious because, on top of everything else, she had a wound from having her claws cut too short, a clipper scratch on her chest, and apparently a burn on her neck (I took her to the vet days later, and they told me it was caused by a hairdryer or clippers). It's unbelievable that after years of taking my dog ​​there, these things are happening now.
They won't face me, they haven't taken responsibility, and they won't admit their mistakes!
Seriously, save yourselves the trouble and spare your dogs the mistreatment! I'M NEVER GOING BACK!!!
Got a great toy for my goldens!!!
The best place for puppies

Incredible! The best place to take your pet for a grooming and haircut, plus they treat them like royalty!! The dogs!! I've been a customer for over a year now and I truly trust them completely because they do a fantastic job and treat the dogs so well.

100% recommended

I've been taking Toñito there for many years and everything has been great. The service they always provide is a bath, nail trimming, and dental cleaning. They've never hurt him, and this time they even put a really nice scarf on him ☺️ Thank you!
Excellent service for my four-legged family!

I have nothing but praise for Spa Pet. We've been customers for over a year now, and every time I take Apolo to their grooming salon, they do a fantastic job. On our last visit, they did a prophylaxis without anesthesia, and his teeth looked amazing. Armando and his entire team are truly professional and friendly. Whenever I go to the vet to see Dr. Jorge (another wonderful and professional doctor), they always treat me with great warmth. They offer many services, such as screwworm vaccination certificates for traveling to the United States, ISO microchipping, urinalysis, blood tests, and more. Don't hesitate to take your dogs here.
It's an excellent grooming salon for my dog, Jochito! They're always friendly and very professional! I come from very far away just to get my dog ​​groomed.
Always an excellent decision to take my puppy
They mistreat the dogs; there have already been several cases of injuries. And they make excuses to avoid taking responsibility.
Bad experience, they hurt the dogs. I took mine and it went badly! They burned him with the machine and refused to take responsibility.

Terrible place, they're inhumane. Don't take your pets there. They left my pet badly injured; I had to take him somewhere else because they came up with excuses about not being responsible. They should investigate the place and the people involved and, of course, shut it down so they don't hurt any more animals.
Excellent service, they always treat her very well whenever I take her, and she's very pampered.
Excellent place to take our little ones. My dog ​​is very anxious and has sensitive skin, and I've never had a bad experience with them. We've been going for almost six years now. 😊 …

I have a Spanish Water Dog and I searched for ages for a place that would groom her properly. I finally found Spa PET and they did a perfect job!
Great service, 100% recommended!
Very good
They hurt my friend's dog horribly, they didn't even warn her... no dog should have to go through that!!!

Very upset and disappointed, SAVE YOURSELF THE FEELING AND BAD MOMENT. My experience with their services had been good in the past, and I even recommended them several times until it was my turn. I had always taken care of my dog ​​Armando there, but today he wasn't there. Initially, I had an appointment at 12 (but I even drove around twice so they wouldn't have him waiting in the cage because they were very busy). I dropped him off at 2:30 and everything seemed fine. They gave him back to me almost at 5, and it was raining. So we got in the car, and when we got there, I saw him licking himself very insistently. Then I noticed that they gave him back to me badly hurt, not with one wound, but with four (a bleeding nail and injuries on his belly, armpit, and leg). I called them very upset and sent them the photos, but they only offered an apology and told me I could put talcum powder on him (which dries them out even more). They said there was no vet available today, but that I could bring him back tomorrow. My dog's fur was already matted, and I even told them to cut only what was necessary so they wouldn't hurt him (they never said they couldn't do it properly). They're supposed to be experts; otherwise, you could do it at home and not stress the animal out. Honestly, I'm very upset, disappointed with the place, and feel helpless. An apology doesn't undo my dog's injuries, and although I had a different perception, now, reading other comments, I see that I'm not the first and surely won't be the last to whom this has happened. It just happened to me this time. I would have appreciated them informing me of the situation when we picked him up. Accidents can happen, but it's clear to me that it was carelessness and even negligence, since he had not one but four injuries. How can I trust them to take him to their vet? I don't know if they were in a hurry, but they even left crooked clumps of fur. Regardless of the cost, which isn't the cheapest in the area, you expect them to return your dog in good condition, at least better than when you left him, and trust in these services is everything. I'm leaving this comment so you can be sure where you leave your dogs and not be the next person to have this bad experience. I also hope the establishment reflects on the quality of their service (which is very different from what they used to offer). These are living beings that can't be cured with an apology. I'll look for another place, but I hope this doesn't happen to anyone else.
Excellent service for your pet, over 30 years and they still treat me incredibly well.

I took my dog ​​in for grooming with a referral and they did something horrible to him. I'll never go back. I was crying after seeing it. They didn't even warn me; they just handed my dog ​​back without saying a word, and then they act like they don't know anything when I complain.
They have the best service, they treat me excellently. I've been taking my pets there for 10 years and everything has been excellent. I recommend them 100%.
Great place. We've been taking Nami and Robin there for years, even though we live in Toluca. They're very attentive and kind, and our little girls look beautiful.
I really enjoy taking my dogs to SpaPet; they always make them look beautiful and the service is excellent. Highly recommended.
I always take Milo. They make him look really handsome. Great service and very communicative.
Excellent service!

An excellent, authentic, and charming place with top-notch service. The whole team is very friendly, and my dog ​​always leaves looking handsome and happy. Since it's in the Roma neighborhood, I take advantage of the opportunity to walk there while I wait, and even though I come from far away, it's 100% worth it.
The best dog grooming, the best service, and above all, love and care for our pets.

It's the only place I trust with my dogs. One of them is extremely nervous, and they're the only ones with the patience to take care of him. I've been going there for over six years, and I wouldn't change them for anything.

I took my dog, a 12-year-old Chihuahua, to this clinic. Other clinics said they couldn't clean his teeth anymore because he wouldn't tolerate the anesthesia, but here, with a technique they have, they were able to. I was surprised that even though my dog ​​is very aggressive when his teeth are touched, he was very docile with them. The procedure was a success; they got rid of the very bad breath he had, and he smiled again. They left his teeth very clean.
They were always attentive to my furry friend; yesterday they performed a dental cleaning and it went excellently. I greatly appreciate their service and attention.

They just cut my dog's hair, and they cut his nail too short. It's bleeding, and when I called them, they said it was normal. Normal, half the bed covered in blood? Never take your dogs there. My dog ​​was a real pain. If anyone knows how to report this to the authorities, check how many complaints they have about the same thing. You can file a complaint now; don't let this happen.

I started by taking Popi there for her haircut, and I loved how she looked when she came out looking so fancy. Since I saw how well they treated the dogs, I also took her in for a dental cleaning, and it went perfectly. I want to emphasize that my dog ​​is 12 years old, and thanks to all the care she's received, she's healthy, strong, and agile for her age. I will definitely keep going because they treat her like a queen.
They have always taken very good care of my dogs for many years.
They burned my cousin's puppy with the machine.
They burned my best friend's dog, and there have been several others like it. Not recommended at all.
Terrible service, they hurt my dog ​​and refused to take responsibility

Hello, don't bring your pets here. They're in danger, they get hurt and leave in terrible condition, and then when you try to contact the spa, they don't know anything and don't answer your call. 🔴🔴 …
EVERYTHING WAS HORRIBLE!!
They injured my cousins' dog, burned him with the clippers, and then returned him infested with fleas. Completely unprofessional service.
Terrible experience, they hurt my friend's dog, they hurt his belly and burned him. Take care of your dogs and save yourself the bad experience.
DON'T GO, they hurt my cousins' dog, the vet told them it was a burn from the machine.

I've been taking my Shih Tzu to SpaPet for three years now. They're the best with my dog, always giving him a thorough bath and a perfect haircut. You can tell they use quality products. Plus, he always comes out looking so handsome!

Excellent place! They're very professional, and the price for pet baths is very reasonable.
Plus, they use a lavender shampoo that leaves my pets' coats looking amazing.
I highly recommend this place; it's been around for many years.
They're not the only ones, but they are the best 5 stars 💫💫💫💫💫 …
I took my dog ​​to get her coat cut for the second time, and this time it went badly. They shaved her, and I won't be going back. Besides, the service was quite slow. I don't recommend it.
I've been taking my dogs there for several years now, excellent service and experts in breed-specific cuts! I highly recommend them.
I love the care and attention they give to Yokas, I live far away, but it's worth it!

Terrible service! I tried to make an appointment for a bathroom session, and a rather feminine-looking guy ended up giving me an unsolicited lecture and even told me I suffer from anxiety. I only asked what their services were and how the bathroom procedure worked. Don't contact them!
My Danoo comes out looking beautiful and happy.
Excellent service! Always very professional and my pets are happy!!

Hi! I've been taking my furry friends there for years and I love the place ❤️ I'm from Ajusco, but the distance doesn't matter, I love how they treat the pets (with so much love and respect). I highly recommend it!! 👍🏻☺️❤️ …
My experience at Spa Pet is amazing; they always make Susanita look gorgeous. They are super professional, and I definitely recommend this place for your pets.
I've been bringing my dogs here for many years, they treat them incredibly well, the best.
They provide excellent service. I like the great care they give Luna. She doesn't leave stressed, and they make her look beautiful.

Good afternoon, what I like most is how professional they are in their treatment of dogs and how attentive they are to each of their clients, always very kind and the treatment of pets is the most important thing. I personally have known Cuauhtemoc for 9 years and he has taken care of my four pets with whom we are very satisfied.
I love how they pamper my dog. A highly recommended place.
As always, excellent service. Leica is a very nervous dog, so you need to be patient with her. Highly recommended ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The service has always been top-notch for both owners and pets; the care they give the dogs is truly appreciated. The service is wonderful.
Chipi and Mili have been going for 7 years, the service is always excellent and they leave looking very handsome and beautiful; thank you SpaPet
I love how they make Goldie look so handsome, and the haircut is always done perfectly!
My experience has been good; a few months ago my dog's teeth were cleaned and it was an excellent job.

We've been taking Amy there for 15 years, and they always make her look impeccable. Haircuts for long-haired dogs are difficult, and they're experts! They're the best at grooming, and they treat your pet, who's part of the family, with love. I trust them completely. All their staff are qualified and always attentive to your needs. We couldn't have found a better place than Spa Pet.

All the groomers at Spa Pet are amazing! My dog ​​is a Cavachon, and they make her look gorgeous. This is my favorite place for baths and haircuts because she's always happy and they give her the "Cavachon look." At other places, they cut her hair in strange ways, like she's a different breed. I love how she looks after her haircut...it's such a feeling when I walk her home with her new hairstyle and bows! 🧡 100% recommended.

It's an amazing place; they treat every dog ​​with such care, and I'm in love with how they groom my old English Sheepdog's coat—they take incredible care of him.

I have another purebred dog, but he's very high-strung, and they know exactly how to handle him to make his experience as calm as possible.

Don't hesitate to bring your little ones!
They've always treated my dog ​​well, and she comes out looking gorgeous after the grooming appointment. Highly recommended!

The care and satisfaction of my Pomeranian is reflected in the professional and personalized work they do every time I take her. This breed needs specific and special care; here I found the whole package! Don't hesitate to take your furry friend to them; you won't regret it! Greetings from my little Cuqui!
I love how they take care of my baby. They always see me at the time I make an appointment.

As always, Ody was very well taken care of and looked very handsome, but above all, I appreciate the way you treat our pets. We've been going to you for two years now, and you'll continue to be our go-to groomers.

Always excellent, they take a little while but the service is worth it. My child always looks beautiful and it's totally worth it. I've been bringing coffee here for a while now and they always have great service.

I don't like to write when I have bad experiences, but I think it's necessary for the well-being of our dogs. Everything was going well until the day of the appointment. We arrived on time, and the young man who attended to us (a young man with very short hair) was very rude and rushed, telling us that he only saw dogs as they arrived (so what was the point of the appointment?). My dog ​​was trembling. He told us it would take 2:30 to 3:00, but that he would have to see the dogs who had arrived earlier. We left him there, but we weren't satisfied, so my husband went back for him. When he asked for him, he noticed that they had him in the back in individual cages with about 10 other dogs. Obviously, he wouldn't be seen in the estimated time if they even saw him at the end. I didn't find the service pleasant.
Good service and attention
The best in Mexico! Excellent attention and service!
It's excellent service and the treatment is great.
